Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
 temp_tbd_count number;
 temp_utr_count number;
 temp_holding_cnt number;
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select test_kit_id, test_type, cut_off_value,
 reconcile_flag, parm_check_flag, kit_lot_number
 into :ctrl_blk_2.test_kit_id, :ctrl_blk_2.test_type,
 :ctrl_blk_2.cut_off_value,
 :ctrl_blk_2.reconcile_flag,
 :ctrl_blk_2.parm_check_flag,
 :ctrl_blk_2.kit_lot_number
 from test_batch_det
 where tb_id = :worksheet_id
 and test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id
 and test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select count(*)
 into temp_tbd_count
 from unit_test_base
 where test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id 
 and tb_id = :ctrl_blk_1.worksheet_id 
 and test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 IF temp_tbd_count > 0 and instr(:stat_msg,'NXTBLK') = 0 THEN
 :stat_msg := :stat_msg || ' [NXTBLK] Unscheduled;';
 END IF;
 select count(*)
 into temp_utr_count
 from utrs
 where test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id
 and tb_id = :ctrl_blk_1.worksheet_id
 and nvl(chapter_id,:GLOBAL.chapter_id) = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 IF temp_utr_count > 0 and instr(:stat_msg,'MENU') = 0 THEN
 :stat_msg := :stat_msg || ' [MENU] Scheduled;';
 END IF;
 select count(*)
 into temp_holding_cnt
 from holding_tests
 where test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id 
 and tb_id = :ctrl_blk_1.worksheet_id 
 and holding_status is null
 and test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 IF temp_holding_cnt > 0 and instr(:stat_msg,'EXEQRY') = 0 THEN
 :stat_msg := :stat_msg || ' [EXEQRY] Holding;';
 END IF;

 exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 end;
 :ctrl_blk_2.s_no_unit := temp_tbd_count +
 temp_utr_count +
 temp_holding_cnt;
 begin
 select test_desc
 into :ctrl_blk_1.s_test_id_desc
 from valid_tests
 where test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 end;
 go_block('reagent_info');
 begin
 select count(*)
 into temp_count
 from test_kit_reagents
 where test_kit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.test_kit_id 
 and test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if temp_count = 0 then
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.test_id');
 show_error('2001');
 else
 execute_query;
 NEXT_ITEM;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 end;
end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare

 CURSOR tbatchNote_cur(pc_tbID VARCHAR2) IS
 SELECT note_id
 FROM test_batch_hdr
 WHERE test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID
 AND tb_id = pc_tbID;
 
 l_sql VARCHAR2(2000);
 ln_noteID NUMBER; 
 lc_id VARCHAR2(20);
begin

 if :ctrl_blk_1.worksheet_id is null then
 show_error('0907');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 lc_id := :ctrl_blk_1.worksheet_id ;
 
 l_sql := 'UPDATE test_batch_hdr ' 
 || ' SET note_id = LN$NoteID ' 
 || ' WHERE test_chapter_id = ''' || :GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID || ''''
 || ' AND tb_id = ''' || lc_id || '''';
 
 
 /* Get the NOTE ID from test_batch_hdr table based on the test batch id selected */
 
 OPEN tbatchNote_cur(lc_id);
 FETCH tbatchNote_cur INTO ln_noteID;
 CLOSE tbatchNote_cur;
 
 
 CALL_WINDOW_FOR_NOTES(pl_notes_for => 'TB_ID', 
 pl_value => 'Test Batch ID - ' || lc_id , 
 pl_sql => l_sql, 
 pl_note_id => ln_noteID);
 

end;

Declare
 nDocs NUMBER:=0;
begin
 if :reagent_type = 'R' then
 :s_reagent_type_desc := 'Reagent';
 elsif :reagent_type = 'C' then
 :s_reagent_type_desc := 'Control';
 elsif :reagent_type = 'S' then
 :s_reagent_type_desc := 'Substrate';
 end if;
 
 if :reagent_info.reagent_code is not null
 then
 select substr(reagent_name,1,20) into :reagent_info.reagent_name
 from valid_reagents where
 valid_reagents.reagent_code = :reagent_info.reagent_code
 and valid_reagents.test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id
 and valid_reagents.reagent_type = :reagent_info.reagent_type;
 end if;
 
 if :supplier_code is not null then
 select substr(supplier_name,1,23) into :reagent_info.supplier_name
 from suppliers where
 suppliers.supplier_code = :reagent_info.supplier_code;
 end if;

 --- check if any documenbts associated with this TB ID
 select count(*) into nDocs from lt_doc_library_values
 where doc_linked_value=:ctrl_blk_1.worksheet_id;
 
 If nDocs > 0 then 
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_tb_documents',enabled,property_true);
 Else
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_tb_documents',enabled,property_false);
 End If;

exception
 when no_data_found then
 :reagent_info.supplier_name := '';
 :reagent_info.reagent_name := '';
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CALL_WINDOW_FOR_NOTES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE call_window_for_notes (pl_notes_for VARCHAR2, pl_value VARCHAR2, pl_sql VARCHAR2, pl_note_id VARCHAR2) IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dondata'; 
BEGIN 

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id);
 end if;
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;


 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_notes_for', TEXT_PARAMETER, pl_notes_for);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_value', TEXT_PARAMETER, pl_value);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_sql', TEXT_PARAMETER, pl_sql);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_note_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, pl_note_id);


 
 call_form( lower('GEWNOTES') ,NO_HIDE ,NO_REPLACE ,NO_QUERY_ONLY ,pl_id);
END;
